items.title: Oil & gas
items.description: Our roots are in offshore drilling operations — environments where safety, reliability, and operational efficiency are paramount. That is where we built the methodology we now apply in other industrial sectors.

items.title: Process industries
items.description: We bring offshore drilling discipline to process plants that cannot stop. We work on reducing non-productive time (NPT), asset integrity, maintenance, and operational visibility — connecting processes and equipment that often run without structured data.

items.title: Energy & infrastructure
items.description: We apply technology and operational management where assets are distributed, maintenance is reactive, and field visibility is low. We integrate data transmission, dashboards, and operational indicators to improve control, reliability, and decision-making.

about.title: About the company
paragraphs: Jatoba Consulting & Technology was born from the founder’s hands-on experience in the offshore drilling industry — more than two decades in critical operations, operational management, maintenance, reliability, and continuous process improvement.

The company brings together professionals with backgrounds in automation, electronics, real-time data transmission, and technology solutions applied to industrial operations. Our focus is to turn operational data into visibility, control, and decision support.

Jatoba Consulting & Technology’s methodology was forged where safety, availability, and operational efficiency are non-negotiable. We carry that operational discipline to industries that depend on critical assets and still have low data integration and limited field visibility.

More than consulting, we deliver integration between operations, technology, and management — connecting people, processes, and equipment to increase reliability, cut losses, and improve operational performance.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.p1: This policy describes how the Jatoba Consulting and Technology (“Jatoba”) institutional website may process personal information provided by visitors, in line with applicable law and sound practice.
privacyPage.p2: When you use contact forms or e-mail channels, you may provide details such as your name, company, phone number, and e-mail address. We use this information solely to respond to enquiries and pursue legitimate business discussions about Jatoba services.
privacyPage.p3: Jatoba applies reasonable safeguards to protect information from unauthorised access or misuse. We do not sell personal data to third parties. Technology providers involved in hosting or transactional mail may receive strictly limited technical access under appropriate contracts and confidentiality duties.
privacyPage.p4: Where applicable, you may ask to correct or delete contact details submitted via this website by reaching out through the Contact section.
privacyPage.p5: Cookies and similar technologies may be used only for site functionality or aggregated audience analytics; further detail can be reflected here once the final technical setup is confirmed.
